items.title:
de.focus-shift:jollyday 2.22.1 发布, This API determines the holidays for a given year, country/name and eventually state/region. The holiday data is
    stored in XML files (one for each country) and will be read from the classpath. You can provide your own holiday
    calendar XML file or use any of the provided ones.

    Currently, there are over 230 countries supported like the following:
    * United States
    * Germany
    * France
    * India
    * Australia
    * and so on

    Besides, those there will be more special calendars like currently existing NYSE calendar (New York Stock Exchange).

items.title:
de.speedbanking:iban-commons-de-checkdigit 1.8.12 发布, Zero-dependency implementation of the German banking industry's account number
        check digit methods ("Prüfzifferberechnungsmethoden in der deutschen Kreditwirtschaft"),
        as catalogued by the Deutsche Bundesbank. Validates whether a Kontonummer is
        structurally consistent for a given method, independently of any IBAN or BLZ
        master-data lookup. Deliberately standalone: does not depend on iban-commons,
        so it can be used on its own by callers that only have a BLZ and Kontonummer
        (e.g. legacy domestic payment processing) and have obtained the applicable
        method number from elsewhere (such as a BLZ master-data module).
